summary.text: Tyler Bridges is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Michael J. Aylesworth. A teacher, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he teaches U.S. history, sociology and AP U.S. Government at Momence Community High School.

paragraphs.text: Bridges was born and raised in Lowell, Indiana, and graduated from Lowell High School in 2016.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University Northwest in 2020 and is working toward a master's degree in political science at Indiana University Northwest.
He said he is a union member through the Illinois Education Association and the National Education Association, and a father of a four-year-old.
Bridges advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
He listed affordability as the first of his campaign's key messages, citing grocery, child care, rent and mortgage costs.
